task.description: WF-03 Step 2, hard gate on CODE-DESIGNER's design. Read lib/letflow/design/iss0911-start-instance-dialog-exact-lookup.md directly. Verify: (1) the fix genuinely calls definitionsApi.getActive keyed on the dialog's own typed value, not the page-level filtered list; (2) the race-guard reasoning (TanStack Query per-key cache/observer isolation preventing a stale response from landing in a superseded key) is actually correct -- read web/src/hooks/useDefinitions.ts and confirm the project's query client is genuinely configured this way (check for any global dedup/staleTime setting that could undermine the claim) rather than accepting the design's assertion at face value; (3) the 5-state version-field model (idle/loading/found/not_found/error) covers every real outcome with no gap; (4) definitionTypeahead's other uses are correctly identified as unaffected, verify this yourself by reading its other call sites in InstanceBoardPage.tsx; (5) no implementation code present -- signatures/shapes only. FAIL immediately on any check failure.
acceptance_criteria: the fix calls definitionsApi.getActive(name) (or an equivalent exact-match backend lookup) keyed on the dialog's own typed value, not the page-level filtered list
a race-guard against out-of-order async responses (rapid typing) is explicitly designed and independently verified correct, not just asserted
the version field's loading/not-found/found states are all specified with no gap
no implementation code in the design doc -- signatures/shapes and control-flow prose only
